booru_tags.label: Booru tags (comma-separated)
booru_tags.instruction: Write comma-separated danbooru-style tags covering the subject, pose, clothing, background, and art style. Include relevant quality tags (e.g. masterpiece, best quality, highres). No sentences, no explanations, no periods.

natural_caption.label: Natural sentence
natural_caption.instruction: Write one natural, grammatically correct English sentence describing the image and its subject.

detailed_caption.label: Detailed description
detailed_caption.instruction: Write a detailed multi-sentence description covering the subject, pose, clothing, background, lighting, mood, and art style.

short_caption.label: Short caption
short_caption.instruction: Write a very short caption of 3 to 8 words that captures the essence of the image.
